videos.title: Tracks WHAT KIND of Criminal You Are in GTA 6 !
videos.summary: GTA 6 introduces a new Criminal Profile system that tracks player behavior. Rockstar says it shares some ideas with Red Dead Redemption 2’s Honor system, but it is designed around how you behave as a criminal rather than simply judging you as good or evil. Your actions may even affect GTA 6’s story and characters. #GTA6 #GTAVI #RockstarGames #GTA6Gameplay #RDR2

videos.title: You Can LOSE Your Cash in GTA 6 💸
videos.summary: GTA 6 separates physical cash from money stored in your bank account. According to Rockstar North’s Rob Nelson, cash carried by the player can be lost after being Wasted, Busted or taken down. Even getting your robbery money home safely could become part of GTA 6’s risk-and-reward system. #GTA6 #GTAVI #RockstarGames #GTA6Money #GTA6Gameplay

videos.title: GTA 6 Has a Full BODY SYSTEM?!
videos.summary: GTA 6 appears to be bringing back deeper character progression systems. Jason and Lucia can eat, work out and potentially change their physical appearance over time, bringing back ideas that GTA fans will remember from San Andreas — but on a much more advanced level. GTA 6 may be much closer to a true open-world life simulator than GTA 5 ever was.
